gloss: the COVID-19 pandemic; the coronavirus crisis

definitions.gloss: the COVID-19 pandemic; the coronavirus crisis (as a period and its hardships)
definitions.explanation: The period of disruption caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, together with the hardships it brought. The suffix {禍|か} means calamity or misfortune, so the word frames the pandemic as a time of trouble rather than just the disease itself.

examples.japanese: コロナ{禍|か}で{生活|せいかつ}が{変|か}わった。
examples.english: Life changed during the coronavirus pandemic.

examples.japanese: コロナ{禍|か}で{多|おお}くの{店|みせ}が{閉|し}まった。
examples.english: Many shops closed during the COVID-19 pandemic.

examples.japanese: コロナ{禍|か}をきっかけに、{在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}が{一気|いっき}に{広|ひろ}がった。
examples.english: Spurred by the coronavirus pandemic, working from home spread rapidly.

notes:
A coinage from コロナ (corona, short for the coronavirus) plus the suffix {禍|か} (calamity, disaster). It refers to the pandemic as a difficult period and became extremely common from 2020 onward. Note that {禍|か} is read か here, not うず.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コロナ{禍|か}で: amid the coronavirus pandemic
- コロナ{禍|か}の{影響|えいきょう}: the impact of the pandemic
- コロナ{禍|か}を{経|へ}て: having gone through the pandemic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新型|しんがた}コロナ: COVID-19 (the novel coronavirus) — names the virus or disease itself, not the period
- {感染|かんせん}{拡大|かくだい}: spread of infection — describes the spreading, not the era as a whole
